label: Episode 33
logline: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
continuity_notes: Following Catherine's dungeon interrogation of Juliana, the conspiracy against Juliana deepens as an aristocratic lord forces a testimony of witchcraft out of the young maid whose brother Juliana saved.

picks.logline: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
picks.hook: "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"
picks.why_it_works: opens on a clear dramatic question; ends on a raised stake; mostly self-contained, needs one line of setup.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 33, 1 segment(s), 42s
[01:09.50-01:13.00] MAID (Begging, Heartbroken): "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"
[01:13.20-01:15.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.
[01:13.20-01:15.00] LORD (Cold, Unwavering): "Then help him."
[01:15.50-01:19.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.
[01:16.80-01:19.00] MAID (Crying, Shattered): "What do you want me to say?!"
[01:19.50-01:24.80] CAMERA: Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.
[01:19.60-01:20.50] LORD (Deceptive): "The truth."
[01:21.00-01:24.50] LORD (Leading, Deliberate): "She drew something around the bed, did she not?"
[01:24.80-01:29.00] CAMERA: Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.
[01:25.50-01:28.80] MAID (Trembling, Reluctant): "She... placed dried herbs around him."
[01:29.00-01:34.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.
[01:29.00-01:30.50] LORD (Hypnotic, Coercive): "Around him."
[01:31.00-01:32.50] LORD (Coercive): "Like a circle?"
[01:33.00-01:34.50] MAID (Faint, Defeated): "Yes."
[01:34.80-01:38.50] CAMERA: Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.
[01:35.00-01:38.00] LORD (Whispering, Trap Snapping): "And she opened her mother's book..."
[01:38.50-01:40.80] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.
[01:38.50-01:40.00] MAID (Sobbing): "Yes."
[01:40.80-01:44.20] CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.
[01:41.00-01:44.00] LORD (Sinister): "...and spoke words you could not understand."
[01:44.20-01:47.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.
[01:44.50-01:46.50] MAID (Desperately Defending): "She was praying!"
[01:47.50-01:51.75] CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.
[01:48.00-01:51.50] LORD (Taunting): "Praying... or chanting?"

CLIP: episode 33, 1 segment(s), 32s
[01:52.00-01:53.50] MAID (Hysterically Sobbing): "I don't know!"
[01:53.80-01:59.50] CAMERA: Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.
[01:54.00-01:56.50] LORD (Calculating, Relentless): "You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs."
[01:56.80-01:59.50] LORD (Relentless): "You saw her use a forbidden book."
[01:59.50-02:03.50] CAMERA: Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.
[01:59.80-02:02.80] LORD (Condemning): "You heard words you could not understand."
[02:03.50-02:06.80] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.
[02:04.50-02:06.50] LORD (Deadly, Resolute): "That is witchcraft."
[02:06.80-02:11.80] CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.
[02:06.80-02:11.50] MAID (Crying Out, Desperate): "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"
[02:11.80-02:14.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.
[02:12.00-02:14.00] LORD (Cold, Final): "That will be your testimony."
[02:14.50-02:17.80] CAMERA: Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.
[02:14.50-02:17.00] MAID (Gasping, Shocked): "My testimony?!"
[02:17.80-02:20.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.
[02:18.00-02:20.00] LORD (Unyielding): "Before the magistrate."
[02:20.50-02:24.25] CAMERA: Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.
[02:20.50-02:24.00] MAID (Wailing, Tormented): "I never said she was a witch!"
